coverage.evidence: The registry and the provider rows group helpers by the first part of the key, and HelperPanel.vue:12 groups the panel the same way. The page's exceptions match the source files: tts and link share helpers are in Helpers/Chat (TtsTextHelpers.cs, LinkShareHelpers.cs); bare link is at TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:745; meter is in Numbers/MeterBarHelpers.cs; pick and chance are in Logic/PickTemplateHelpers.cs and ChanceTemplateHelpers.cs; event values bits, tier and months are at TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:389,395,431. Every docs page in the list exists under src/content/reference/en/templates, and user.mdx:40 and target.mdx:35 hold the Pronouns and grammar anchors. The count of 909 comes from docs-work/helpers.json meta (product commit 2a4c81b1c), and git log 2a4c81b1c..HEAD shows no commit to the Templating folders since then.

{args.<n>} is registered at TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:665 as a prefixed family. The Use in labels map to the TemplateHelperContext sets: Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord and Webhook (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-39), plus Viewer (TemplateHelperContext.cs:63, TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:75-79). {bits} uses EventSourceAndDiscordContexts, which is EventResponse, Pipeline and Discord (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:109-114,430-435), and that matches event.mdx:22. Exactly 7 pages (activity, ad, args, bot, channel, charity, chat) have no Use in column (grep count 0), as the page says.

TemplateField.vue:151-164 opens suggestions after a brace. Lines 196-205 handle ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter and Tab. Lines 222-233 put the Show all helpers toggle in the label row (en.json:200). HelperPanel.vue has Search helpers (en.json:205), inserts at the remembered caret (TemplateField.vue:180-183) and shows a 'Becomes {sample}' row (en.json:209), with the text.upper sample HELLO at CaseTextHelpers.cs:19. panel=false is set on Your line (EventResponseEditor.vue:230), on list items (ListField.vue:142) and on every Discord field except Message and Description (RuleEditor.vue:299-449). The info icon is FieldInfo.vue, and 'You can use: {names}' is at event-responses en.json:53 and EventResponseEditor.vue:111-119. 'Not a known helper here' is at en.json:199 and is shown non-blocking at TemplateField.vue:296-305. Event narrowing is TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:144-171 through TemplatesController.cs:59-78. Save validation and its messages are TemplateHelperValidator.cs:34-104 and TemplateSurfaceAvailability.cs:145-157, called by CommandService, EventResponseService, TimerManagementService, DiscordNotificationConfigService and OutboundWebhookEndpointService.

A colon starts the inputs and a pipe separates them (TemplateParser.cs:148-157). {text.repeat:3|ha} gives hahaha because the default separator is empty (PadTextHelpers.cs:52-59). {text.cut:hello world|max=8} gives 'hello w…': the named max is read at TextArguments.cs:37-45, and Cut keeps max minus the length of the default end '…' (CutTextHelpers.cs:32-46). A token with no value prints as written (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19-21, TemplateResolver.cs:27).
